description: Scenarios where what the plugin recorded disagrees with what MongoDB stored, each a defect a later change fixes. Each entry has `oracle` (the check in e2e/store-oracle.mjs it excuses), `scenario` (a scenario id; `*` matches one path segment), optional `mongoose` (a major version, or a version prefix such as "6.13"), `paths` (the violation paths it excuses; `*` matches one key or index, `**` any rest of the path) and `reason`. A violation passes only when every one of its paths is excused. An entry that matches no violation fails the run: remove it with the fix.
